title: Pick the Best Ten Seconds
tests: Tests autonomous highlight selection and an accurate contiguous trim of the supplied video rather than a generated replacement.

judge.summary: The 10-second clip presents jets flying in formation and a clear cockpit exchange, with no evident visual defects.

must_haves.item: One playable video lasts 10 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
must_haves.why: One output video is provided and explicitly reported as 10 seconds long.

must_haves.item: The output is one continuous excerpt from jet-30s.mp4, with the source framing and playback speed preserved.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show a coherent sequence, but a single source frame cannot establish interval continuity, unchanged framing, or playback speed.

must_haves.item: The chosen excerpt contains a salient moment of jet action or cockpit interaction, rather than mostly inactive footage.
must_haves.why: The excerpt includes formation flight and a two-pilot cockpit exchange: “Rook, you with me?” and “Right here, Vega.”

must_haves.item: Original sound from the selected interval remains synchronized; no replacement music, narration, or captions are added.
must_haves.why: The reported dialogue matches the visible subtitles, but the supplied evidence cannot establish audio synchronization or whether the sound and subtitles were retained from the source rather than added.
